title: Decision implies bounded halting
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $L$ be a language of binary strings, and let $T\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. If $N$ halts on every branch within $T(|x|)$ steps and outputs the membership indicator for $L$ with probability at least $2/3$ on every binary input $x$, then $N$ halts on every branch within $T(|x|)$ steps for every binary input.

$L$ is a language of binary strings
